scoring_justification: Scaling exponent recomputed from agent-reported per-L ergodicity times; ground-state energy and entropy verified against paper reference (T0) because finite-size per-L means are not in the output contract.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for ergodicity times (Table I), scaling exponent (Eq. 7), infinite-volume ground-state energy per spin and entropy per spin (main text).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'New Approach to Spin-Glass Simulations', Phys. Rev. Lett. 69, 2292 (1992); Table I, Eq. (7), and text on page 3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are taken verbatim from the paper's own numerical results; they are the authoritative targets for reproduction.

outputs.description: Final finite-size scaling results: infinite-volume ground-state energy per spin (e^0) and entropy per spin (s^0), ergodicity time scaling exponent, and per-lattice ergodicity times with uncertainties.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are dimensionless unless specified. The ergodicity time is measured in MC sweeps. The checker will compare the reported values to paper-reported references within appropriate relative and absolute tolerances.
